## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Package or area

For example `packages/fcitx5-windinput-git`, `scripts/`, or `.github/workflows/`.

## Checklist

- [ ] PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO are consistent (`makepkg --printsrcinfo` matches the committed file)
- [ ] Checksums were verified against a fresh download, or the source is VCS and this is documented
- [ ] README.md and VALIDATION.md describe what was tested and what was not tested
- [ ] Chinese documentation under `docs/zh-cn/` is updated for changed documentation
- [ ] No binaries, build outputs, caches, secrets, or unrelated files are included

## Validation performed

List the commands you ran, for example `bash scripts/validate.sh <pkgbase>`, and their results.

## Not tested

Be explicit about what you could not verify.
